jobs.description:
Senior Lecturer in Biomedicial Laboratory Science
Reference number PAR 2026/891
The University of Gothenburg tackles society’s challenges with diverse knowledge. 58 000 students and 6800 employees make the university a large and inspiring place to work and study. Strong research and attractive study programmes attract researchers and students from around the world. With new knowledge and new perspectives, the University contributes to a better future.
At the Institute of Biomedicine, the scientific focus is on gaining a fundamental understanding of the living cell, its composition, how it functions, how its function is regulated by the genome, and how it interacts with its surroundings. This knowledge is used to investigate the causes of various disease conditions, with the aim of developing new opportunities for diagnosis and treatment. The Institute is responsible for the Biomedical Laboratory Science Programme, which includes teaching in areas such as molecular cell biology, clinical chemistry, and pathology. Further information about the Institute’s activities is available on its website:https://www.gu.se/en/biomedicine
Subject area 
Biomedical Laboratory Science.
 
Subject area description 
Biomedical Laboratory Science is an interdisciplinary field of science grounded in medicine, natural sciences, statistics, and technology. The discipline encompasses theoretical and methodological knowledge of laboratory medical and physiological analytical and examination methods used to analyse biological samples, study physiological processes, and assess body function in health and disease.
Central to the discipline are pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical processes, including sample collection, method selection, analysis, interpretation, and quality assurance of results. The discipline also encompasses the development, validation, and quality assurance of analytical and examination processes, with relevance to diagnostics, monitoring, prevention, patient safety, and research.
 
Duties 
The position involves extensive teaching responsibilities, including course coordination and serving as an examiner within the Biomedical Laboratory Science Programme, the supplementary education programme for biomedical laboratory scientists with foreign qualifications, and courses at the second-cycle level.
Teaching encompasses both basic laboratory methodology and theoretical and practical teaching in courses focusing on clinical chemistry, haematology and/or clinical pathology. Teaching also includes profession-specific components related to the professional practice, responsibilities, and scope of competence of biomedical laboratory scientists. The successful candidate will also collaborate with clinical laboratory services within the healthcare sector to ensure the professional relevance of the education and that students’ knowledge and skills are assessed in relation to the requirements established by the national qualitative targets for the biomedical laboratory science profession. 
As a course coordinator, the successful candidate shall, in collaboration with other teaching staff, lead, plan, and develop courses within the programme, with the patient in focus. The duties may also include supervising biomedical laboratory science students during their degree projects. The successful candidate shall also participate in the development and revision of the programme syllabus for the Biomedical Laboratory Science Programme. The position may also include responsibility for the entire programme.
The successful candidate shall also conduct independent, nationally competitive research within the field of biomedical laboratory science, apply for research funding, and establish scientific collaborations with other research groups at the University of Gothenburg and other higher education institutions.
 
Eligibility 
Eligibility requirements for appointment to a teaching position are specified in the Higher Education Ordinance and the University of Gothenburg’s Appointment Regulations.
A doctoral degree in Biomedical Laboratory Science or another discipline deemed equivalent by the employer, demonstrated teaching proficiency, Swedish professional status qualification as a biomedical laboratory scientist, and the ability to teach in both Swedish and English.
 
Assessment criteria 
The assessment criteria for appointment to a teaching position are specified in the Higher Education Ordinance and the University of Gothenburg’s Rules of Procedure.
Greatest weight will be given to teaching proficiency. In assessing teaching proficiency, particular consideration will be given to experience in education and teaching within biomedical laboratory science, particularly haematology, clinical chemistry, clinical pathology, advanced therapy medicinal products (ATMPs) and/or precision diagnostics, responsibility for teaching administration, and pedagogical development work. Teaching proficiency must be demonstrated through documentation of completed courses in higher education pedagogy, teaching experience, experience in pedagogical development work, and responsibility for teaching administration. Proficiency must be well documented in a manner that enables an assessment of the quality of the teaching activities.
Secondly, scientific proficiency will be considered. Scientific proficiency must be demonstrated through scientific publications, assessed in terms of both quantity and quality, contributions to scientific conferences, the ability to secure research funding in national and international competition, and supervision of doctoral students. Proficiency must be well documented in a manner that enables an assessment of the quality of scientific activities.
Thirdly, documented experience of clinical laboratory work within clinical chemistry, haematology, clinical pathology, molecular diagnostics and/or methodologies relevant to future laboratory practice, such as ATMPs and precision diagnostics, will be considered.
Fourthly, administrative proficiency and experience will be considered, demonstrated through documented experience of leadership responsibilities and/or collaboration within various organisations, both within and outside academia.
 See more info on the University of Gothenburgs homepage job opportunities.

Development Engineer - Gas Customized Trucks
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.

Imagine a Lego kit: are you the type of person who feels accomplished after building the model according to the instructions, or do you enjoy reimagining and rebuilding it in new ways? At Customized Trucks, we embrace Scania’s modularity to craft innovative solutions tailored to our customers' needs. We utilize the "Lego" concept extensively, and sometimes, we even modify the "Lego bricks" to ensure they fit perfectly together.
Our responsibility spans the development of customized trucks across various domains, including alternative fuels, electrification, and specialized applications such as mining, heavy haulage, and fire trucks. Every project we undertake begins with a direct customer request, ensuring that our solutions are precisely aligned with their unique requirements.
 
Job Responsibilities
The tasks we handle range from routine adaptations, which you can process several times a week, to complex solutions that may require extensive projects. This broad scope and varying complexity offer endless opportunities for you to develop your skills and grow. No two weeks will ever be the same!

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Conducting technical investigations of customer requests. When an order is placed, you will describe the adaptation in the product description system and on drawings.
• Product ownership of our special gas solutions and ensuring their maintenance over time.
• Participating in development projects and creating new designs for CNG, LNG, and hydrogen trucks as needed.
• Addressing and resolving field quality issues as they arise.

One of the most exciting aspects of our job is the ability to follow a product from the initial customer request all the way to when the truck leaves the production line!
Who You Are
 
To excel in this role, we believe you should be a driven, proactive, and curious individual who isn't afraid to ask questions. You thrive on handling a variety of tasks that may change quickly and enjoy getting hands-on with technical issues when needed. Your positive and enthusiastic attitude makes you a great team player who fosters knowledge sharing and propels the team forward.

We also look for the following qualifications:

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, or equivalent work experience.
• Previous experience in S-order is beneficial but not mandatory.
• At least 3 years of experience in product development.
• Fluency in both written and spoken English.

Experience with Scania products, our modular system, and Catia V5 is advantageous. It is also meritorious if you have worked with gas and hydrogen solutions before.
This Is Us
 
Our group within the Customized Trucks department specializes in designing gas trucks, including CNG and LNG, at a complete truck level. Recently, we were also involved in the exciting task of developing customized hydrogen solutions.
We are a team of nine development engineers and one group manager, and we take great pride in our diversity. Our team members come from various gender identities, ages, life experiences, and cultural backgrounds. We foster an open and supportive work environment where we enjoy our work and support each other.
We operate within a value flow, maintaining close contact with other cross-functional teams such as Sales and Marketing, Project Management, Aftermarket, Production, Purchasing, and Certification. This means you will build a broad Scania network from day one!
 
Scania Offers
 
We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions. Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally through a structured development plan and various courses.
Our benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or a wellness allowance, a result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also hosts
events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents can enjoy direct access to Södertälje via the Scania Job express buses.
 
Application
 
Your application should include a CV, cover letter and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes. Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-03. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role. If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: magda.blosinska@scania.com We look forward to your application!

jobs.occupation: Postdoc in machine learning for materials design
jobs.description:
Work assignments 
The primary focus of the position is on developing and applying artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) methods for large-scale computational materials discovery. The research aims to advance data-driven materials science through the development of methods for exploring vast spaces of possible materials, identifying promising candidates, and guiding the discovery and design of new materials with desired properties.
 
The work includes the development and application of physics-informed machine learning models, generative AI methods, machine learning interatomic potentials, and high-throughput computational workflows. The research may also involve computational physics methods, studies of materials stability and properties, and data-driven approaches to understanding and predicting materials synthesizability.
 
Particular emphasis will be placed on efficient methods and software for massively parallel GPU-accelerated computations on high-performance computing (HPC) systems. The aim is to contribute to our AI-driven materials design platform to enable large-scale screening and inverse design of materials, with potential applications in, e.g., quantum information processing, energy storage, and electronic and optoelectronic devices.
As postdoc, you will principally carry out research. A certain amount of teaching may be part of your duties, up to a maximum of 20% of working hours.
Qualifications
To be qualified to take employment as postdoc, you must have been awarded a doctoral degree or have a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree.  This degree must have been awarded at the latest by the point at which LiU makes its decision to employ you.
It is considered advantageous if your doctoral degree is no older than three years at application deadline for this job. If there are special reasons for having an older doctoral degree – such as taking statutory leave – then these may be taken into consideration.
Your application must include documents that clearly show that you fulfill the following requirements for the position:
A doctoral degree in physics, materials science, computational science, or equivalent. A course transcript with grades must be included in the application. 
A publication list that includes multiple co-authored research publications in computational materials science, materials informatics, machine learning, and/or related areas of computational science.
Co-authored publications demonstrating experience with the development or application of AI/machine learning methods for prediction of materials properties or other applications in materials discovery.
Experience with high-throughput computational materials science, automated computational workflows, or large-scale materials datasets.
Extensive documented programming experience, particularly in Python, demonstrated, for example, through co-authored publications describing the use of Python and links to open-source software to which the applicant has contributed.

It is considered a strong merit for the position if your application shows documented experience, in particular in relation to materials science, of (i) developing new AI/machine learning methods (beyond applying existing ones); (ii) experience with generative AI methods, such as flow matching and diffusion models; (iii) development or fine-tuning of machine learning interatomic potentials; (iv) GPU-accelerated computing and high-performance computing (HPC), particularly using Python-based frameworks such as JAX.
It is considered a merit for the position if your application shows other documented experience demonstrating a high level of understanding and skill in the fields of solid-state physics, thermodynamics, statistical mechanics, crystallography, and crystal symmetries.
You are expected to be creative, independent, and intellectually curious, and to have a high level of engagement and motivation to contribute to materials science and the development of AI-driven methods for materials discovery.
The workplace
More information at: https://liu.se/en/research/materials-design-and-informatics
The employment
This employment is a temporary contract of two years with the possibility of extension up to a total maximum of three years.
 
The employment is full-time.
Starting date by agreement.
Salary and employment benefits
At Linköping University, salaries are set individually and differentiated, in accordance with the applicable collective agreements (RALS/RALS-T) and the university’s salary-setting guidelines.
More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.
Union representatives
Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.
Application procedure
Apply for the position by clicking the “Apply” button. Your application must be received no later than 17 December, 2026. 
 
 
 
Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered. 
 
 
 
Please attach your selected research publications electronically, in pdf or word format, in the application template. Research publications, e.g. monographs, which cannot be sent electronically should be sent in three sets by mail to the University Registrar at Linköping University, University Registrar, S-581 83 Linköping, Sweden. The publications must be received by Linköping University no later than the deadline for application.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Fullstack Engineer to join our CLM & eSign team in Solna. You’ll work with modern cloud-based technology, take ownership of technical decisions and help us build scalable, secure solutions for digital signing and contract lifecycle management.
About us
At Verified, we build cloud-based solutions for identity verification, electronic signing and Anti-Money Laundering (AML). Our platform supports AML/KYC, supplier due diligence and secure digital workflows.
We’re around 100 people, mainly serving the Nordic market, with a user network that spans Europe. Our API-first platform lets businesses integrate secure, scalable services into their existing systems and workflows.
Technology is at the heart of what we do, and we keep investing in cloud infrastructure, scalable architecture and AI-driven solutions. We work closely across different parts of the platform, with a strong focus on technical quality, knowledge sharing and building reliable solutions.

Design and develop scalable cloud-based systems, REST APIs and modern web applications.

Use AI agents, RAG and automated workflows to improve our products and development processes.

AI is an important investment area for us. Our engineering organisation is exploring a more agentic approach to software development, so you’ll have the chance to shape how AI is used across the development lifecycle and built into our products.
We see software engineering as a craft, where technical quality, thoughtful decisions and pragmatic solutions go hand in hand.

At least five years of experience in software development, preferably in cloud-based SaaS environments.

Strong experience with ASP.NET Core, C# .NET and Node.js, alongside React.

Experience building REST APIs, microservices and distributed systems.

A good understanding of event-driven architecture and asynchronous communication.

Hands-on experience with AWS and databases such as SQL Server and DynamoDB.

A strong understanding of system design, security, scalability and modern application architecture.

Experience with, or an interest in, AI tools and modern development workflows.

Professional proficiency in English and the right to work in Sweden.

As a person, you’re curious, analytical and self-driven, with a strong sense of ownership. You enjoy technical discussions, sharing knowledge and finding practical solutions that balance quality, performance and business needs.
What we offer
With us, you’ll work on technology that helps businesses manage critical digital processes securely and efficiently. You’ll join an experienced engineering environment with significant influence over architecture, technical decisions and development practices, and you’ll help shape how we use AI and modern technologies across Verified.

Significant influence over technical decisions and product development.

An experienced team with a high degree of autonomy and shared ownership.

Modern cloud technology, distributed systems and AI-driven development.

30 days of vacation, plus five “Verified days” for bridge days and holiday flexibility.

Job Title: PSIRT Operational Specialist
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. As an PSIRT Operational Analyst, you will play a key role in protecting connected vehicles, digital platforms, and services from evolving cyber threats. Working within the Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT), you will move between incident response, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity risk mitigation across our products and ecosystems.

· Experience contributing to security communities such as FIRST, ENISA, CSIRT networks, or similar.
 
This Is Us

We are a collaborative and skilled cybersecurity team responsible for protecting TRATON's products and services from evolving cyber threats. Expanding across brands, technologies, and international teams, we combine deep technical expertise with a strong culture of trust, continuous learning, and teamwork.
Our mission is not only to respond to cybersecurity incidents, but also to proactively strengthen security capabilities, improve resilience, and support the secure development of future transportation solutions. With us, your actions will have a direct impact on the company's cybersecurity status.
 
Who Is Your Manager
I am here to support you and the whole team in being successful and taking the necessary steps toward fulfilling our goals and stakeholders' expectations. Join Truecaller – The place where innovation meets impact!
Truecaller's mission is to build trust in communication by making it safer, smarter, and more efficient. Born in Sweden, trusted by the world, and here’s why we stand out:
We are trusted by over 500 million active users every month across 190+ countries
We identify over 15 billion calls daily, helping users avoid spam and scams
We are powered by a team of 400+ employees from 45+ nationalities

We always look for people who take initiative, own their work, and keep raising the bar. An entrepreneurial mindset matters here, especially when it turns bold ideas into real actions. We stay collaborative and focused, always searching for smarter paths forward. If you want to make an impact and grow with a team that inspires millions, you’ll fit right in.
The role
You will lead the Decisioning squad as its most senior data scientist: data scientists, ML engineers, and backend engineers across Stockholm and India, reporting to the Associate Director, Revenue Intelligence, in Stockholm.
This is a hands-on leadership role. You will still write models, run the offline evaluations, and read the experiment results yourself. You will also set the modelling direction for the squad, decide which problems are worth solving next, and hold the bar on how a model earns its way into production.
The work has a direct commercial edge. The squad's models decide which ads run and at what price on Truecaller's largest ad surfaces, so a better model shows up in revenue within weeks. The next step is to move from choosing the campaign to setting the bid: one decision that combines a calibrated conversion probability with price, pacing and frequency.
What you'll do
Own the modelling roadmap for decisioning - conversion prediction, ranking, campaign selection and bidding - and agree it with product and engineering.
Design, build and run production models end to end, from problem framing and features through offline evaluation, A/B tests and monitoring.
Evolve the contextual bandit from choosing which campaign to show to setting a per-request bid, with exploration, off-policy evaluation and safe rollout built in.
Keep model scores honest: calibration per campaign and placement, and a clear link between offline metrics and the revenue and conversions advertisers actually see.
Set the bar for experimentation in the squad: every model change ships with a holdout, an agreed success metric, and a clear ship or kill rule.
Lead the squad: set the technical direction, review designs and code, run the prioritisation, and grow the data scientists, engineers and interns around you. You are accountable for what the squad ships, not only for your own work.
Write the RFCs and decision records the group works from, and present results and trade-offs to product, commercial and executive leadership.
Work with backend and data engineering on serving latency, feature pipelines and data quality, so models run reliably at very high throughput.
Raise the data science practice across Revenue Intelligence and the wider discipline through reviews, shared methods and mentoring.

What you bring in
7+ years in data science or applied machine learning, including several years owning models in production that real revenue depends on.
Depth in ranking, recommendation, or conversion prediction at scale - multi-task learning, deep learning, gradient-boosted models, and calibration.
Hands-on experience with online learning or decision systems, such as contextual bandits, exploration strategies, and off-policy evaluation.
Strong experimentation skills: A/B test design, power, causal reasoning, and telling a real lift from noise.
Expert Python and SQL, with a modern deep learning framework (TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch) and a cloud warehouse at real scale. We run on GCP and BigQuery; equivalent depth on another stack transfers.
Technical leadership of a team: setting direction, reviewing other people's work, and raising the quality of the people around you.
Strong written English. You will write the RFCs, evaluation reports, and design docs, and they will be read by people who were not in the room.
Comfort operating across Stockholm and India time zones.

It would be great if you also have
Ad tech experience - real-time bidding, auctions, pacing, attribution or campaign delivery.
Experience with the India digital advertising market and performance advertisers.
An MSc or PhD in computer science, statistics, mathematics, or a related field.
Experience taking models to low-latency serving, and the MLOps around it: model registries, monitoring and automated retraining.
Exposure to privacy-constrained modelling, such as GDPR and India's DPDP Act.
Experience applying LLMs to modelling or analysis work.

The research group focuses on improving diagnostics and advancing our understanding of central nervous system (CNS) tumours through epigenetic and molecular approaches. Our research particularly focuses on DNA methylation profiling, nanopore sequencing, and the analysis of patient-derived samples, including liquid biopsies. We combine advanced sequencing technologies with bioinformatic method development and multiomics analyses to develop new diagnostic and prognostic tools and gain deeper insights into tumour biology. Close collaborations with pathologists, neurosurgeons, and oncologists at Sahlgrenska University Hospital support the group's strong translational research focus. 
Duties 
We are seeking an experienced and independent researcher with strong expertise in bioinformatics and a particular interest in computational method development within cancer research. The position focuses on developing and applying advanced bioinformatic methods for sequencing data analysis, with particular emphasis on nanopore sequencing, epigenetic modifications, liquid biopsy, and integrated multiomics analyses.
The successful candidate is expected to independently develop novel computational methods and bioinformatic pipelines and contribute to the design and execution of research projects within the group.
Responsibilities include:
Independent development, implementation, and optimisation of bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines for large-scale sequencing data.
Development of analytical methods for DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing data, including the identification and quantification of DNA methylation and other nucleic acid modifications.
Development and application of bioinformatic methods for liquid biopsy analysis, particularly cell-free DNA (cfDNA), using nanopore sequencing and enzymatic methyl-seq (EM-seq).
Development of computational approaches for the analysis of RNA modifications from sequencing data.
Integration of genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic data through advanced multiomics analyses.
Development of robust and reproducible computational pipelines, including evaluation and validation of novel analytical methods.
Independent statistical analysis, visualisation, and biological interpretation of complex datasets.
Scientific responsibility for the bioinformatic aspects of research projects, including study design, methodological decisions, data interpretation, and scientific publication.
Collaboration with experimental and clinical researchers, as well as supervision of junior researchers and students in bioinformatics.

 
Qualifications 
Required qualifications
PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, or another relevant discipline with a strong computational focus.
Several years of documented experience in independent bioinformatic research and computational method development.
Extensive expertise in the analysis of large-scale sequencing data, particularly DNA methylation arrays and nanopore sequencing.
Documented experience in developing and implementing bioinformatic methods and computational pipelines.
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of DNA methylation and other epigenetic modifications.
Experience in the analysis of liquid biopsy data, RNA modifications, and/or integrated multiomics datasets.
Excellent programming skills, for example in Python and R, and experience working in Linux-based computational environments.
Demonstrated ability to independently design, conduct, and lead bioinformatic research projects.
A strong scientific publication record in relevant research areas.
Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary research environment.

Meriting qualifications
Experience in bioinformatic analysis of liquid biopsy data using nanopore sequencing and EM-seq.
Experience in developing methods for identifying RNA modifications from nanopore-based direct RNA sequencing.
In-depth knowledge of epigenetics, DNA methylation, and epigenetic tumour classification.
Research experience in CNS tumours or other areas of cancer research.
Experience in integrating genomic, epigenomic, and transcriptomic datasets.
Experience with high-performance computing (HPC), version control, and reproducible computational workflows.
Experience in translational research and the development of bioinformatic methods for diagnostic applications.

Employment 
The position is temporary, 11 months, full time and is placed at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.

Mälardalen University (MDU) is the youngest university in Sweden. In line with our vision, to be a progressive and collaborative University where we shape a sustainable future together, we wish to make a difference.Do you want to be involved and contribute to our development?Together, we can create a sustainable future through knowledge and innovation. We believe that knowledge and new perspectives are best attained and reached together in collaboration with others – our colleagues, students, the private and public sectors, both nationally and internationally.The Faculty of Engineering and Health Sciences provides education and conducts research in engineering, health and information design, with a clear focus on addressing societal challenges. Our research is carried out in close collaboration with external partners, both nationally and internationally, and contributes to knowledge development and innovation. Through our collaboration platforms, we bring together academia, the public sector and industry to jointly drive knowledge development and strengthen the relevance of research and education. Education at all levels is research-based and closely aligned with the needs of society and working life. Together, we contribute to sustainable societal development.The Faculty comprises three departments with a total of approximately 500 staff.The Department of Computer Science and Engineering conducts internationally recognised research in close collaboration with industry, the public sector and other higher education institutions, in areas including artificial intelligence, dependable systems, embedded systems, and medical and health technologies. The department educates students in fields such as computer science, software engineering, computer networks, applied AI, dependable systems, cybersecurity, and intelligent embedded systems.
Employment information
 
Employment: Temporary employment, 2 years
 
Period of employment/Start date: March 2027 or as soon as possible
 
Scope: Full time
 
Number of positions: 1
 
Closing date for application: 2026-12-31
 
Campus location: Västerås
 
School: Datavetenskap och datateknik
Position description
The purpose of the position is to give the employee an early opportunity to develop his or her independence as a researcher and to create the conditions for further acquisitions of qualifications after completing the doctoral degree. The position is a temporary employment with a maximum period of 3 years. 
As postdoc in the Chips-JU uPQComing project, the candidate is expected to lead their line of research, both individually and in collaboration with other project members, both at MDU and in the consortium. The tasks involved in the employment include also co-supervision of PhD students, project meetings, participation and presentation at research venues as well as project reporting events. The postdoc is expected to teach for 10% of their employment time.
Qualification requirements
The applicant is required to have a PhD in Physics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or Quantum Computing
The applicant must have completed the degree no more than three years before the end of the application period. You have not previously held a position as a postdoctoral researcher in the same or related subject area at MDU that exceeds one year.
Documented research in quantum computing is required. The candidate shall demonstrate advanced skills in conducting both research and implementation tasks (e.g. first-/single-author publications, own GitHub repository, etc.). Written and oral communication skills: demonstrates the ability to communicate ideas clearly and persuasively, both in writing and orally. This includes the ability to articulate complex concepts in accessible language during one-to-one meetings and presentations to both small and large groups. Requirements for employment are the ability to teach and conduct research in English.
This position involves work within a research project where access to certain research results, methods, technical systems, software or other information may be regulated by export control, security or sanctions legislation. The successful candidate must therefore be able to meet the requirements set out in the relevant legislation in order to gain access to the project’s research environment and to be able to carry out the duties of the position. A security clearance or other legally justified checks may be carried out if the nature of the position requires so.  
Assessment criteria
For this position, particular emphasis will be placed on: 
Documented knowledge and research in (post-)quantum cryptography and/or cybersecurity is considered a merit
Knowledge of digital-twins is considered a merit
Documented collaborations with researchers outside their own supervision team and/or with industry are considered a merit

 Join our team

Experience from controlling within production, supply chain or distribution and from consolidation systems such as Tagetik or similar is an advantage.

 Learning & Development programs
 Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
 Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
 Global Parental Leave Policy
 Community involvement

This is an opportunity to contribute to a high-impact technology project while developing your project leadership skills with support from experienced colleagues. We are looking for an Early-Career ASIC Project Manager to strengthen Axis ASIC development in Lund.

What is Axis?
Axis is a fast-growing and highly innovative company offering intelligent security solutions. Our network video and surveillance solutions help create a safer and smarter world.
Our success comes from our skilled people and our culture of openness, collaboration, and innovation. At Axis, we do more than create products - we shape solutions that deliver value to our customers.

The Axis ASIC Department develops custom ASICs that accelerate essential functions in our surveillance cameras. We design, develop, implement, integrate, and verify hardware modules that help strengthen Axis' technology leadership.
Our hardware blocks support functions such as image processing, video compression, radar, audio, and computer vision. We also work closely with external vendors who provide third-party IP cores.
The ASIC development team brings together colleagues with a range of experience and expertise. We value an open working environment and collaborative, low-ego teamwork.

Your tasks will include:
Coordinating work across internal and external interfaces, including software, algorithms, electronics, product teams, and partners
Tracking project progress, coordinating priorities, and communicating plans and status.
Planning and following up on deliveries to and from other projects and external partners, such as third-party IP core providers
Helping track and visualize the project budget
Supporting technology intake activities within the ASIC Department

You will build your project leadership skills while developing your understanding of the technical and commercial aspects of ASIC development. An interest in technology and working with external partners is important. Experience in technical or commercial negotiations is a plus.

You have a technical background and are curious about ASIC development and the technology behind complex products. You enjoy creating structures, connecting people, and helping a team make progress towards a shared goal.
You don't need to have held a formal leadership role. You may have developed relevant skills through your studies, a thesis project, an internship, or your first professional role. What matters is your interest in taking responsibility, supporting collaboration, and growing into project leadership.
We believe you have:
A master's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, physics, mathematics, or a related field. A bachelor's degree in a relevant field may also be suitable, depending on your experience and overall profile.
Some knowledge of ASIC development, or a strong interest in learning about technology.
An interest in project planning, coordination, and follow-up.
Clear communication skills and the ability to create shared understanding.
Familiarity with agile ways of working, or an interest in learning them.
Good communication skills in English and Swedish.

You bring your own perspective, ask questions, and enjoy working with people across different disciplines. You value collaboration and are motivated to help a team succeed. At Axis, you'll have the opportunity to develop your technical understanding and project leadership skills with support from experienced colleagues.

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.
Here, you'll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance - developing solutions used worldwide.
